boundaries: Bird 1981-2024 is not a preidentified disturbance-recovery phase; it is a prospective positive-net-change allocation test.
Emperor results use posterior-median colony abundance indices; no joint posterior probability for E is claimed.
Emperor full-roster multiplicative G decomposition is undefined because one 2009 colony posterior median is zero; the colony remains in primary N/E analysis.
The algebraic common/contrast decomposition is not claimed as novel mathematics.
No universal directional recovery rule is claimed.
